MOOD server module.

Handle commands and store game parameters.

class mood.server.MUD¶

A key class for the game, storing all information about players and monsters.

addmon(name, hitpoints, x, y, speech)¶

Add a new monster to a game monsters list.

Parameters:

  • name – the monster’s name.

  • hitpoints – the monster’s hitpoints.

  • x – monster’s position on the X-axis.

  • y – monster’s position on the Y-axis.

  • speech – the monster’s speech.

Returns:

string to be printed to the player after creation.

attack(player, name, damage)¶

Handle the attack on the monster.

Parameters:

  • player – player attacking a monster.

  • name – the monster’s name.

  • damage – the maximum damage that can be dealt to a monster.

Returns:

string to be printed to a player after the attack.

encounter(x, y)¶

Create monster’s message.

Parameters:

  • x – X-coordinate.

  • y – Y-coordinate.

Returns:

monster’s message.

move(player, x, y)¶

Handle move command and call player.move…() function.

Parameters:

  • player – player to be moved.

  • x – player’s bias along X-axis.

  • y – player’s bias along Y-axis.

Returns:

string to be printed to the player after moving.

async wanderMonsters()¶

Handle the functionality of wandering monsters. Move a random monster one cell in random direction.

class mood.server.Monster(name, hitpoints, x, y, speech)¶

A class stores monster information and handle attacks on it.

attacked(damage)¶

Attack the monster.

Parameters:

damage – the maximum damage that can be dealt to a monster.

Returns:

a tuple with the damage dealt and remaining hitpoints.

class mood.server.Player¶

A class stores player information and handle their movements.

moveHorizontally(flag)¶

Move the player horizontally.

Parameters:

flag – player’s movement direction.

moveVertically(flag)¶

Move the player vertically.

Parameters:

flag – players movement firection.

printPosition()¶

Create a message with a new player’s position and monster message.

Returns:

string to be printed to the player.

async mood.server.main()¶

Run a game.

async mood.server.serve(reader: StreamReader, writer: StreamWriter)¶

Create client-server interaction.

Parameters:

  • reader – reading stream.

  • writer – writing stream.
